name: OpenAI Agents API

form_factor.comment: Managed coding-agent API accessed through official SDKs and hosted OpenAI environments. Per-form-factor links: SDK: https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/agents-api/overview; Hosted Agent: https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/agents-api/environments/openai-hosted.

released_in.comment: OpenAI launched the Agents API in public beta on September 10, 2026.

latest_major_update.comment: The September 10, 2026 public beta introduced persistent sessions, versioned agent configurations, built-in tools, skills, MCP, subagents, hosted or self-hosted execution, live observability, and webhooks.

rules.comment: Saved agent configurations support reusable instructions and behavior, but the API docs do not define a repository instruction-file convention.

skills.comment: Plugins can package discoverable skill directories and supporting resources for the Codex harness.

hooks.comment: Session lifecycle events can be delivered to application webhook endpoints.

mcp_servers.comment: Agent configurations can connect the harness to remote MCP servers.

custom_commands.comment: The hosted API has no documented slash-command or command-file interface.

goal_command.comment: Sessions accept tasks and follow-up input, but no persistent `/goal` command is documented.

subagents.comment: The Codex harness can delegate work to specialized subagents within an agent run.

monitor.comment: Applications can stream run events live, inspect traces, and subscribe to lifecycle webhooks.

model_selection.comment: Saved agent configurations specify an OpenAI model and reasoning settings.

approval_mode.comment: Applications control tool and environment permissions, but the public API docs do not describe a built-in interactive per-action approval UI.

sandbox_mode.comment: Runs can use isolated OpenAI-hosted containers with network policy or application-managed self-hosted environments.

resume.comment: Persistent session IDs let applications reconnect to and continue existing work.

continue.comment: Applications can send follow-up messages and steering input to an existing session.

non_interactive.comment: The product is an API designed for programmatic and asynchronous agent execution.

output_format.comment: Agent configurations support output controls, while session event streams provide structured responses.

statusline.comment: The API has no terminal statusline.

telemetry.comment: Runs expose structured traces and observability data for application monitoring.

custom_model_provider.comment: The public Agents API documentation supports OpenAI models and does not document arbitrary external model providers.

notes: Public-beta managed agent API powered by the open-source Codex harness. It is listed separately from Codex CLI because it is an independently launched hosted API surface. It has no installable local command, so no agent-launch backend is added.

pricing.value: No additional Agents API fee; model tokens, tools, and hosted containers billed at API rates
pricing.comment: OpenAI states there is no separate Agents API charge; normal model, tool, and hosted-container usage rates apply.

some_free_usage.comment: The public launch describes usage-based API billing and does not document a product-specific free tier.

no_account_required.comment: An OpenAI API account and API key are required.

can_use_other_subscriptions.comment: The hosted API is billed as API usage; ChatGPT subscription authentication is not documented for this surface.

hosted_agent.comment: OpenAI provides managed isolated environments for cloud agent execution.

transcripts.comment: Sessions persist their input, output, tool, and event items for later retrieval.

transcript_location.value: Hosted service sessions; input/output/tool/event items retrieved via API
transcript_location.comment: Sessions persist their input, output, tool, and event items for later retrieval.

keyboard_shortcuts.comment: The API has no interactive keyboard interface.

theme_customization.comment: The API has no product UI theme.

auto_save.comment: Session state and items are persisted by the managed service.

debugging_output.comment: Live event streams and traces expose tool calls, outputs, errors, and run state.

context_window.comment: The service manages long-running session context and compaction, but does not expose an arbitrary context-window size control.

code_formatting.comment: No built-in formatter setting is documented; agents can invoke tools supplied by the environment.

git_integration.comment: Hosted environments can work with repository files and code, but the API docs do not document a dedicated pull-request integration.

performance_mode.comment: Model and reasoning-effort configuration can trade latency for capability, but there is no separate named performance mode.

ui_customization.comment: The API supplies no end-user interface to customize.
